description: GP DONNEES METIERS - RESEAUX-SECS - FIBRE_OPTIQUE is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. It is an entity class game with data from the fibre optic network, and its accessories, of Grand Poitiers Networks. In particular, there are: cable layout, duct layout, chambers, optical connection points and technical rooms. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "GP DATA METIERS — NETWORKS-DRYS — FIBRE_OPTIQUE" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include hautdébit, grandpoitiersnetworks, télécommunications, internet, fibresoptiques, gpn. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
